description: Draft a formal EU261/UK261 compensation claim letter (subject, legal basis, amount, 14-day payment request, escalation notice) for the passenger to send themselves, plus sending tips. Nothing is sent. Use after check_compensation and pass its amount. Do NOT use to check eligibility; use check_compensation.

arrival.description: Arrival airport 3-letter IATA code, case-insensitive, e.g. JFK

claimed_amount.description: Amount claimed, e.g. 600. If omitted, computed from the route like check_compensation (EUR 250/400/600 or GBP 220/350/520 by distance); required if an airport is unknown.

currency.description: Currency of the claim. Default GBP for UK261, EUR for EU261.

departure.description: Departure airport 3-letter IATA code, case-insensitive, e.g. LHR

incident_summary.description: One sentence on what happened, e.g. "the flight arrived 4 hours late due to a technical fault". Default generic wording.

passenger_name.description: Passenger's full name as on the booking, e.g. "Jane Smith"

scheme.description: Legal basis. Default: UK261 if departing the UK, else EU261 (without claimed_amount, worked out from the route; errors if neither applies).

name: generate_claim_letter

disclaimer.description: Not-legal-advice disclaimer to show the user.

letter.description: Full letter text, ready to copy and send.

scheme.description: Legal basis used in the letter.

sending_tips.description: Practical tips for sending and follow-up.

subject.description: Suggested email or letter subject line.

title: Generate claim letter
